displayStrings.noDeviceFound: No wearables found - ensure device is advertising

infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: KEEL uses Bluetooth to scan and connect to any smartwatch, Apple Watch via companion, or wear gear for health monitoring.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: KEEL needs Bluetooth to find nearby heart rate and fitness devices.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KEEL shows your live location, hiking trails within 5km, and nearby public users on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: KEEL can track your route in background during a training session.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: KEEL reads heart rate, steps, sleep, workouts, SpO2 from Apple Health. Apple Watch data comes via Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: KEEL can save workout sessions to Apple Health if you allow.
